panels.title: Panel
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape the panel.

panels.title: Online now
panels.description: Users with a live connection right now, as reported by the daemons.

panels.title: Daemons online

targets.expr: sum(frostbite_daemon_up and on(daemon_id) frostbite_daemon_enabled == 1) or vector(0)

panels.description: Enabled daemons with an open link.

targets.expr: count(frostbite_daemon_up == 0 and on(daemon_id) frostbite_daemon_enabled == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Download now
panels.description: Billed traffic towards users, after each node's multiplier.

panels.title: Traffic, last 24 h
panels.description: Read from the hourly traffic table, so it is right even right after a restart.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Billed traffic over every node. Counted from usage reports, so it starts when the panel does.

panels.title: People and daemons
panels.description: 'Online users' is live from the daemons. 'Seen in the last hour' counts users whose traffic was booked.

panels.title: Users over time
panels.description: Growth, and what happens to users as they hit limits or expire.

panels.title: Expiring soon
panels.description: Cumulative: a user ending tomorrow is in every row.

panels.title: Blocked
panels.description: Cut off for using more addresses than their limit allows.

panels.title: Over their limit
panels.description: At or over the traffic limit. They become 'limited' on the next enforcement pass.

panels.title: How much of their limit users used
panels.description: Only users that have a traffic limit.

panels.title: Activity
panels.description: Users whose traffic was booked within each window.

panels.title: Owners
panels.description: Who created the users: admins and resellers.

panels.title: Client apps
panels.description: From the user agent of each user's last subscription fetch.

panels.title: Devices registered
panels.description: Users with a device limit register each client the first time it fetches.

panels.title: Never fetched sub
panels.description: Nobody opened their subscription link yet.

panels.title: Online addresses
panels.description: Distinct source addresses over all online users.

panels.title: Heaviest users this period

targets.expr: topk(20, (frostbite_user_traffic_used_bytes * on(user) group_left(status, plan, owner) frostbite_user_info))
(frostbite_user_traffic_limit_bytes * on(user) group_left(status, plan, owner) frostbite_user_info) and on(user) topk(20, frostbite_user_traffic_used_bytes)
(frostbite_user_traffic_used_bytes / (frostbite_user_traffic_limit_bytes > 0) * on(user) group_left(status, plan, owner) frostbite_user_info) and on(user) topk(20, frostbite_user_traffic_used_bytes)
((frostbite_user_expire_timestamp_seconds - time()) * on(user) group_left(status, plan, owner) frostbite_user_info) and on(user) topk(20, frostbite_user_traffic_used_bytes)

panels.description: Needs per-user metrics (on by default). Traffic this period resets according to each user's schedule.

targets.expr: ((frostbite_user_expire_timestamp_seconds - time()) * on(user) group_left(status, plan, owner) frostbite_user_info) < 14 * 86400 > 0
(frostbite_user_traffic_used_bytes * on(user) group_left(status, plan, owner) frostbite_user_info) and on(user) ((frostbite_user_expire_timestamp_seconds - time()) < 14 * 86400 > 0)
(frostbite_user_traffic_used_bytes * on(user) group_left(status, plan, owner) frostbite_user_info) and on(user) frostbite_user_online_addresses
((frostbite_user_blocked_until_timestamp_seconds - time()) * on(user) group_left(status, plan, owner) frostbite_user_info)
(frostbite_user_ip_limit * on(user) group_left(status, plan, owner) frostbite_user_info) and on(user) frostbite_user_blocked_until_timestamp_seconds

panels.title: All recorded
panels.description: Everything in the hourly table, which is kept for 400 days.

panels.title: Node traffic limit used
panels.description: Nodes with a traffic limit only. Counts raw traffic, before the multiplier.

panels.title: Rolling 24 hour traffic
panels.description: Traffic of the 24 hours before each point, from the panel's own counters.

panels.title: Raw and billed throughput
panels.description: They differ when a node has a multiplier other than 1, or when usage belongs to users that no longer exist.

panels.title: Heaviest users
panels.description: Per-user throughput. Needs per-user metrics, and resolves to the scrape interval.

targets.legendFormat: usage reports at or over the limit

targets.expr: topk(20, (frostbite_user_traffic_lifetime_bytes_total * on(user) group_left(status, plan, owner) frostbite_user_info))

panels.title: Traffic by owner
panels.description: Traffic used this period by the users of each administrator.

panels.title: Daemon link
panels.description: Green while the daemon has an open link to the panel. A daemon that is disabled shows as down.

panels.title: Daemons
panels.description: 'Connected since' and 'Last seen' are relative to now; 'In sync' means the daemon runs the revision the panel wants and reported no error.

panels.title: Configuration errors
panels.description: Why a daemon refused its last configuration. Empty when everything applies.

panels.title: Revisions behind
panels.description: How far each daemon trails the configuration the panel wants it to run.

panels.title: Reconnects
panels.description: A link that keeps coming back points at a flaky network or a daemon crash loop.

panels.title: Refused daemon connections
panels.description: Missing or unknown tokens, failed upgrades and bad hellos.

options.content: Reported by each daemon every 15 seconds. Daemons on the same machine report the same host.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Used memory excludes reclaimable cache.

panels.title: Disk used
panels.description: The root filesystem.

panels.title: Network out
panels.description: Every non loopback interface, so traffic through docker bridges can be counted twice.

panels.title: Swap
panels.description: Empty on hosts without swap.

panels.title: Network errors and drops
panels.description: Errors and drops per second, summed over interfaces.

panels.title: File descriptors
panels.description: Allocated system wide, against the kernel limit.

panels.title: Daemon goroutines
panels.description: Of the daemon program itself, not the core it drives.

panels.title: Report age
panels.description: Seconds since the daemon last sent its health. Should stay under 15.

panels.title: Certificates, days left
panels.description: Automatic certificates renew by themselves about 30 days before they expire.

panels.title: Inbounds
panels.description: Without the system inbounds that bridges create.

panels.title: Plans
panels.description: A limit of 0 means unlimited.

panels.title: Webhooks
panels.description: Enabled webhooks.

panels.title: Database schema
panels.description: Latest applied migration.

panels.title: Spec pushes
panels.description: A push goes out when a daemon's configuration changes or when it connects.

panels.title: Spec builds
panels.description: Rejected means the panel refused to send a configuration, for example a missing certificate or an unsupported combination.

panels.title: Rebuild time
panels.description: Recomputing every daemon's configuration. Runs after any change, bursts collapse into one pass.

panels.title: Daemon commands
panels.description: Restarts, log requests and connection tests started from the panel.

panels.title: Usage booking time
panels.description: Time to book one usage report against users, nodes and the hourly table.

panels.title: Usage for unknown users
panels.description: Usage from users that were deleted while connected. A steady stream suggests a daemon with a stale configuration.

panels.title: Enforcement changes
panels.description: Users the quota loop changed: resets, expiries, limits, activations and lifted blocks.

panels.title: Enforcement pass
panels.description: One pass runs every few seconds.

panels.title: Queue
panels.description: Events waiting for delivery.

panels.title: Dropped, 24 h
panels.description: Dropped because the queue was full.

panels.title: Alerts remembered
panels.description: Entries in the log that stops the same alert going out twice, kept for 90 days.

panels.title: Telegram API calls
panels.description: getUpdates is the bot's long poll and runs all the time while the bot is on.

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Requests being handled right now, not counting daemon links.

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Signed in browsers across all administrators.

panels.title: Panics
panels.description: Handlers that crashed in the selected time range.

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: Of all requests except long lived connections.

panels.title: Refused credentials
panels.description: Requests that arrived without a valid session ('none' is a browser that is not signed in) or with a bad API token.

panels.title: Subscription downloads
panels.description: 'auto' picks the format from the client's user agent.

panels.title: Administrator actions
panels.description: Everything that lands in the audit log, as it happens.

panels.title: Query time, p95
panels.description: Per sqlc query. Hand written queries are grouped as 'other'.

panels.title: Waiting for a connection
panels.description: Should hug zero. If not, queries queue for a connection.

panels.title: Table size
panels.description: Including indexes.

panels.title: Table rows
panels.description: Estimated from statistics.

panels.title: Dead rows
panels.description: Waiting for vacuum.

panels.title: Hourly traffic table
panels.description: One row per user, node and hour. Pruned after 400 days.

panels.title: Metric refresh time
panels.description: How long the database queries behind this dashboard take. They run at most every 10 seconds.

panels.title: Metric age
panels.description: Seconds since each group of database metrics last refreshed successfully.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: 1 means one full core.

panels.title: Scrape time
panels.description: How long Prometheus waits for /metrics. Mostly the database queries, which are cached for 10 seconds.

panels.title: Series exposed
panels.description: Grows with users when per-user metrics are on, and with nodes and inbounds.

options.content: Needs the `node-exporter` service of the monitoring profile. Nodes report their own health under *Nodes and daemons*.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Physical interfaces only, so traffic through docker bridges is not counted twice.

panels.title: Newest backup
panels.description: Age of the newest file.
